tasks.prompt: You are planning a weekend hiking trip with friends, but you saw a weather forecast predicting heavy rain and thunderstorms. You need to inform your friend, Sarah, who is organizing the trip, and suggest an alternative plan.
bullets: ● Tell her about the weather forecast.
●  Explain why you think hiking is not a good idea.
●  Suggest an alternative indoor activity for the weekend.
tasks.subject: Weekend Hiking Trip

tasks.instruction:
In your response, you should do the following.
   ●  Express and support your opinion.
   ●  Make a contribution to the discussion in your own words.
An effective response will contain at least 100 words.

professor.name: Dr. Diaz
professor.text: In today’s fast-paced world, technology is everywhere, significantly impacting our daily lives and learning environments. High schools globally are integrating technology into classrooms, but is this shift beneficial or detrimental? On one hand, technology offers informational resources and learning opportunities, making education more accessible and engaging. On the other hand, technology can distract students and reduce face-to-face interaction. How can high schools best integrate technology in their curriculums to enhance learning? Please share your opinion about this.

posts.name: Paul
posts.text: I believe training teachers to integrate smartphones effectively into the high school curriculum is key. It’s not just about using technology; it’s about enhancing learning. If teachers can guide students on how to use smartphones as educational tools, they can make learning more engaging and avoid students’ being distracted.

posts.name: Claire
posts.text: Integrating technology into education is crucial for preparing students for a digital future. By familiarizing students with technology, high school teachers can equip them with essential tech skills needed in almost every career path today. Digital devices make learning more interactive and accessible, ensuring students are ready for the technological advancements they will face.
